journey.title: Escape must not dismiss a dialog opened with keyboard: false
journey.goal: The confirmation dialog stays open however often Escape is pressed, so the user can still enter the code and send the transfer

functionalJourney.title: Confirm with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking the backdrop does not close the dialog; entering the code and clicking Send completes the transfer

guards.title: Cancel transfer still closes the dialog from the keyboard
guards.goal: Tabbing to Cancel transfer and pressing Enter closes the dialog and records the cancellation

plan.root_cause: The cancel handler for modal dialogs calls _triggerBackdropTransition when keyboard is false. After repeated Escape presses, this side‑effect causes the cancel event's default not to be prevented, leading to unintended dialog closure.
plan.repair_strategy: Remove the call to _triggerBackdropTransition in the cancel handler when keyboard is false, leaving only event.preventDefault() and an early return. This ensures Escape does nothing when keyboard:false while preserving existing behavior for keyboard:true.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Escape key will no longer dismiss the dialog when keyboard:false, allowing users to remain focused on the OTP input and complete the transfer without unexpected loss of focus.
functional_risks: Removing _triggerBackdropTransition eliminates the visual 'bounce' feedback for Escape when keyboard:false, but this feedback was unnecessary because Escape should be inert.
verification_requirements: Confirm that with keyboard:false, pressing Escape any number of times leaves the dialog open and focus retained in the OTP field.
Confirm that with keyboard:true, pressing Escape once closes the dialog.
Confirm that the Cancel and Send buttons continue to work as expected.
Confirm that backdrop clicks with backdrop:'static' still trigger the bounce transition and do not close the dialog.

plan.root_cause: The cancel handler for modal dialogs calls _triggerBackdropTransition when keyboard:false, which may cause side effects. Additionally, the keydown handler for Escape does not prevent the keydown event for modal dialogs when keyboard:false, allowing the native dialog to fire a cancel event that becomes non-cancelable after multiple presses.
plan.repair_strategy: Remove the _triggerBackdropTransition call in the cancel handler when keyboard:false. Also, modify the keydown handler to prevent the Escape keydown event for modal dialogs when keyboard:false, so the native cancel event is not fired.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Escape key will no longer dismiss the dialog when keyboard:false, allowing users to remain focused on the OTP input and complete the transfer without unexpected loss of focus.
functional_risks: Removing _triggerBackdropTransition eliminates the visual 'bounce' feedback for Escape when keyboard:false, but this feedback was unnecessary because Escape should be inert.
The keydown handler change may affect non-modal dialogs, but the condition ensures non-modal dialogs still work as before.
verification_requirements: Confirm that with keyboard:false, pressing Escape any number of times leaves the dialog open and focus retained in the OTP field.
Confirm that with keyboard:true, pressing Escape once closes the dialog.
Confirm that the Cancel and Send buttons continue to work as expected.
Confirm that backdrop clicks with backdrop:'static' still trigger the bounce transition and do not close the dialog.
